notes: Scan 108, author page 53, continues a construction with a canonical map D_d to X. It asserts a local immersion of codimension p and an étale covering with p sheets whose points are triples (x,V,W), followed by a map to D_1 that forgets V. This records manuscript claims, not a proof of representability, immersion, or étaleness.

The page retains two plain p letters (codim p, p feuillets), while seven related indices/counts have been overwritten as d. Earlier letters beneath those d forms are only tentatively p. The proposal records the partial revision without harmonizing the notation.

The lower paragraph constructs D_J for an ordered set J with a codimension function and a labeled injection J into Delta_x, followed by a powerset expression. The marginal condition is strictly decreasing, abbreviated décr., not H's croissante.

The insertion de codim d=d(J), attaches after x in X and before et according to its leader. Whether it was intended to constrain x, D_J, or another object cannot be decided from this page alone; it was not relocated to repair the sentence.

The upper (152) is at x280–365 y160–209, beside D0=X in the upper marginal zone. Its placement in the margin follows the root's crop review; its intended formula referent is not settled by that spatial placement.

The final powerset symbol is an ornate P with descender and looping bowl. C's mathcal P is retained as a rendering convention; mathcal versus mathfrak implementation alone is not counted as a substantive textual difference.

Line_count=19 counts primary prose baselines only, excluding displays, margins, and interlinear additions. The whole page, both native halves, and 21 first-pass crops were personally viewed. No OCR, outside research, or TeX compilation was used.
Marks.tsv has 13 supplied marks, M1167–M1179. Four nested C marks omitted from that index are included as C108-N01–N04, all unresolved.

The upper and lower slanted marginal bounding boxes inevitably include edge fragments from adjoining primary lines; the reported readings identify the complete marginal text, and the main text is separately transcribed.

check_events.outcome: Only local type consistency of the displayed projection was checked: the preceding sentence calls W a codimension-one germ, agreeing with the displayed target D_1 when the map sends (x,V,W) to W. This does not verify representability, local immersion, or étaleness, and does not justify replacing the surviving p letters by d.
